questions.question_text: Explain the meaning of the key vocabulary term 'Holistic' in the context of 'Yoga–a Way of Life'.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Definition: Comprehending the whole person (mind, body, spirit) rather than individual parts.. Example: Yoga is a holistic approach to health.

questions.question_text: Provide a detailed summary (80-100 words) of 'Yoga–a Way of Life', highlighting the character actions and moral outcome.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Yoga offers comprehensive physical, mental, and spiritual benefits. Physically, it increases muscle strength, joint flexibility, and body posture while relieving lower back pain. Mentally, its emphasis on pranayama (breath control) and quiet focus calms the nervous system, reduces test anxiety, and sharpens concentration. By uniting thought and action, yoga serves as a lifelong foundation for holistic health.

questions.question_text: Target Grammar Concept in Chapter 11: What is the rule regarding 'Practice (Noun) vs Practise (Verb) & Advice vs Advise'?
options: A) Words ending in -ce (practice, advice) are nouns; words ending in -se (practise, advise) are verbs.
B) All verbs must be in future tense.
C) Nouns do not change form.
D) Adjectives are excluded from sentences.
questions.correct_answer: A) Words ending in -ce (practice, advice) are nouns; words ending in -se (practise, advise) are verbs.
